questions.stem: A 34-year-old male presents to the emergency department with shortness of breath and multiple injuries. The patient got injured when his house collapsed, and the roof fell on him. Chest X-ray shows massive hemothorax on the left side. ICD insertion is done on the left side, and the patient is shifted to the operation theater. Which of the following defines a massive blood transfusion?
